ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2025 DPS (paid, fy_fact, period ended 2025-12-31) — the quarterly facts since and a year earlier are on different tags (declared/paid), so the year is not rolled forward
dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2007-12-31..2026-03-31; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2026-06-30..2026-06-30, 1 facts); paid FY facts for 1 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2025-12-31); both tags file quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-06-30 and neither has stopped — declared is primary (paid becomes primary only when the declared tag has had no fact for 330 days while paid continues)
dividends.frequency_basis: cash dividends paid are filed for 4 of the last four quarters (2025-09-30: 96.2M, 2025-12-31: 96.9M, 2026-03-31: 97.0M, 2026-06-30: 97.2M) — the cash dividend is paid every quarter; the per-share facts read annual (spacing of the latest 4 positive quarterly DPS facts (2024-03-31, 2025-03-31, 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30)) because they are filed on a declaration cadence, not a payment cadence
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.price_note: price: neither prices.json nor score.json carries a price — yields null
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

dps_basis: declared facts for periods ending 2007-12-31..2026-03-31; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2026-06-30..2026-06-30, 1 facts); paid FY facts for 1 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2025-12-31) — the series switches basis where one tag stops; the switch year can double-count or skip one payment (a dividend declared in one quarter and paid in the next)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (365 days between 2024-03-31 and 2025-03-31) — FY2025 DPS (paid, fy_fact, period ended 2025-12-31) — the quarterly facts since and a year earlier are on different tags (declared/paid), so the year is not rolled forward

frequency: the FY2025 total is a paid fact and the quarterly facts inside that year are declared facts — the payment count needs both from one tag, so the cadence is read from the spacing of the quarterly facts
